subject: Three different friendly pterosaurs grouped on an ancient rock outcrop, all smiling triumphantly.

foreground.pterosaur_1: Pteranodon: Three-quarter view, gentle happy smile, a prominent smooth crest, soft teal-grey leathery skin, positioned prominently looking at the screen.
foreground.pterosaur_2: Dimorphodon: Three-quarter view, cheerful smile showcasing friendly rounded puffin-style jaw profiles, fuzzy pycnofiber coat, positioned beside Pteranodon.
foreground.pterosaur_3: Tapejara: Three-quarter view, brave happy smile, a massive colorful sail-like head crest, in the background looking contented and waving a wing-finger.

composition.background: Open, sunny prehistoric sky over a coastal canopy with distant rolling hills and a clear blue horizon. Celebratory, light, and airy atmosphere.
composition.grouping: Pterosaurs are perched and posed in a way that conveys happiness and success, looking out directly at the player.

caption_1.style: Bright red, thick 3D mixed-case block letters, positioned top-center.

caption_2.style: Shiny gold, bold 3D mixed-case block letters, positioned clearly below 'Ptero Smile!', with a subtle celebratory sparkle effect. Text is slightly textured, like polished gold.

visual_logic.overall_mood: Celebratory, rewarding, successful. Emphasizes the positive, smile-focused outcome of the game.
visual_logic.color_palette: Bright sky blues, sunlit yellows, lush canopy greens, with the red and gold captions standing out cleanly.
